definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a number, yen amount, or percentage to express a price reduction. The rendaku form of {引|ひ}き (pulling, subtracting).

examples.japanese: ⟦{五百|ごひゃく}→五百：12738_gohyaku⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{引|び}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一|いっ}⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧{引|び}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Members can purchase all items at 10% off.

notes:
Voiced form (rendaku) of {引|ひ}き. Attaches to a number expressing how much is taken off a price.

COMPOUNDS:
- {一|いっ}⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧{引|び}き: 10% off
- ⟦{半|はん}{額|がく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧{引|び}き: half-price off (more often just ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧)
- ⟦{千|せん}{円|えん}→千円：08980_senen⟧{引|び}き: 1,000 yen off
- ⟦{学割|がくわり}→学割：18217_gakuwari⟧{引|び}き: student discount

USAGE:
For percentages, Japanese normally uses ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ (= 10%): {三割引|さんわりびき} (30% off). For yen amounts, the figure plus ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ attaches directly: {三百|さんびゃく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{引|び}き. Often appears on store signs and coupons.
